title: v2 judge output (one evaluation call)
description: The judge returns verdicts only; the runner computes all scores. The runner must additionally validate that verdict ids exactly match the spec's checkpoint ids, one entry each, in file order.

evidence.description: File name + verbatim code quote proving the verdict. Empty string permitted only for 'missed' when no relevant code exists.

react_rule_violations.description: Unambiguous Rules of React violations, each proven by its quoted evidence alone. Any entry triggers the runner's rules gate (final score × 0.6). Empty array when none found.

evidence.description: File name + verbatim code quote proving the violation

anti_patterns_observed.description: Anti-patterns spotted while reading (see anti-patterns.md), with file references. Informational; does not affect the score.

strengths.description: Notable positive observations beyond the checkpoints. Informational.
